item.text: I found the startup check: it uses `Authentication.Enabled()`, which becomes true for JWT and triggers `getDB` on non-database storage. I’m checking the existing tests and cleanup path before adding a regression test.

item.text: The root cause is broader than the database check: the current database-free branch returns before JWT middleware is installed. I’ll keep authentication setup running with an in-memory auth store, and open the database only when the storage backend or an enabled auth method needs it.
